# Colour scale for heteroscedasticity diagnostics

<small>Source: [`R/ggplot_extensions.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/ggplot_extensions.R) · Help: `?scale_colour_hetero_diagnostic`</small>

Provides a discrete palette used across diagnostic comparisons.

## Usage

```r
scale_colour_hetero_diagnostic(...)

scale_fill_hetero_diagnostic(...)
```

## Arguments

`...`
:   Arguments passed to [`ggplot2::scale_colour_manual()`](https://rdrr.io/cran/ggplot2/man/scale_manual.html).

## Value

A ggplot2 scale.

## Examples

```r
ggplot2::ggplot(mtcars, ggplot2::aes(wt, mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  scale_colour_hetero_diagnostic()
```
